# HelpMyIMG — Complete Technical Documentation & LLM Knowledge Graph (llms-full.txt)
# Canonical URL: https://helpmyimg.com/
# Last Updated: 2026-11-20

## 1. System Overview & Technology Stack
HelpMyIMG is a client-side image manipulation, privacy redaction, and computer vision platform engineered to eliminate server uploads for modern photo editing workflows.

### Architectural Pillars:
1. **Runtime Execution:** Pure client-side TypeScript, WebAssembly (WASM SIMD), WebGPU, WebGL2 shaders, and OffscreenCanvas Workers.
2. **Model Architecture:** Neural segmentation & upscaling compiled for ONNX Runtime Web (`briaai/RMBG-1.4` Starter, `BiRefNet Lite` PRO WebGPU, `Swin2SR` 4K upscaler, plus custom C/WASM alpha matting refinement) running inside isolated Web Workers.
3. **Codecs & Raw Support:** Pure WASM codecs via jSquash (MozJPEG, OxiPNG, WebP, AVIF, JXL, MagicKernelSharp), `libraw-wasm` (camera RAW), `heic-to` (HEIC/HEIF), `ag-psd` (Photoshop PSD), `utif` (TIFF), and `esm-potrace-wasm` (raster-to-SVG).
4. **Data Isolation:** Image data remains strictly in volatile client memory (`ArrayBuffer`, `Blob`, GPU textures). Zero file upload, zero server retention.

---

## 2. Pricing & Plan Model (Accurate Specification)
- **Free Starter Tier ($0):** Full client-side access to all tools, unlimited standard HD (1080p) exports with zero watermarks, up to 10 photos per batch, plus 3 free 4K original-resolution AI exports per day when signed in.
- **PRO Studio ($9.99/month or $79/year):** Unlocks BiRefNet Lite WebGPU matting, Swin2SR 4K lossless upscaling, unlimited 100+ batch ZIP archives, ad-free workspace, and unified suite access.
- **Founder Lifetime Pass ($129 one-time):** Permanent PRO access across all 4 ecosystem web apps (`HelpMyIMG`, `HandleMyFile`, `SolveMyMedia`, `CreateMy-QR`).

## 3. Canonical Tool Endpoints (Verified Live URLs)

### 3.1 AI Background Eraser (Remove Background)
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/remove-background/`
- **Dedicated Sub-Tools:**
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/remove-logo/`
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/remove-person-from-photo/`
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/magic-brush/`

### 3.2 Precise Target Image Compressor
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image/`
- **Target Presets:**
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-100kb/` (Strict gov portal / visa / application forms)
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-50kb/` (Avatar, signature, and compact uploads)
  - `https://helpmyimg.com/compress-image-to-200kb/` (E-commerce and editorial web assets)

### 3.3 Biometric Passport & ID Photo Studio
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/change-background/`
- **Dedicated White Preset:** `https://helpmyimg.com/change-background-white/`
- **Presets:** Crimson Red (`#DB1514`), Royal Blue (`#00529C`), Official White (`#FFFFFF`), studio gradients.

### 3.4 AI Metadata, C2PA Cleaner & EXIF Studio
- **Metadata & C2PA Cleaner:** `https://helpmyimg.com/ai-metadata-cleaner/` — Losslessly strips C2PA manifests, AI watermarks/chunks, GPS tags, and camera history in RAM.
- **Camera EXIF Studio:** `https://helpmyimg.com/edit-exif/` — Inspects, edits, or injects camera make/model, lens, exposure settings, copyright, and timestamps.

### 3.5 Advanced WebGL 60 FPS Photo Studio
- **Canonical Endpoint:** `https://helpmyimg.com/advanced-editor/`
- **Capabilities:** Real-time GPU color grading, LUT film presets, crop & transform, draggable text overlays, smooth brush drawing, high-resolution JPEG/PNG/WebP export.

### 3.6 Resizing, Format Conversion, Privacy Blur & Watermark
- **Resize:** `https://helpmyimg.com/resize-image/`, `https://helpmyimg.com/resize-image-for-instagram/`, `https://helpmyimg.com/resize-passport/`
- **Crop & Rotate:** `https://helpmyimg.com/crop-image/`, `https://helpmyimg.com/rotate-image/`
- **Convert:** `https://helpmyimg.com/convert-image/`, `https://helpmyimg.com/convert-webp-to-jpg/`
- **Blur & Privacy:** `https://helpmyimg.com/blur-face/`, `https://helpmyimg.com/blur-license-plate/`
- **Watermark & Color Picker:** `https://helpmyimg.com/watermark-image/`, `https://helpmyimg.com/batch-watermark-photos/`, `https://helpmyimg.com/image-color-picker/`
